sourceReview.reason: Full TokenPost Nov 16 report (https://www.tokenpost.com/news/regulation/58160) attributes roughly sevenfold year-on-year growth to Paul Chan but provides no comparable dated starting/ending fund AUM figures or directly accessible original Nov 16 statement. SFC-related reporting dated Oct 9 (https://clb.org.hk/en/business/SFC-17-tokenised-retail-products-launched-AUM-reaches-US-1-3-5e0acd) instead reports 78% annual growth for 17 tokenised products, while Nov 6 analysis (https://www.blockhead.co/2026/11/06/hong-kongs-sfc-counts-17-tokenised-retail-products-and-floats-a-tokenised-gold-etf-as-its-next-pilot/) traces an older sevenfold comparison to March 2026 and warns metrics may not be comparable. The Oct 26 24/7 trading development is already covered in a separate reviewed Hong Kong inbox story. Sevenfold claim, metric dates and independent fresh event are insufficiently verified; retry no sooner than six hours.
